notes: Fastned vehicle page chart data (the page embeds a per-percent kW series); Fastned says the curve shows the car on its network with the battery in optimal conditions (around 30 °C), and a colder or warmer battery can charge much slower. Sampled every 5 % plus the first, last and peak points. Fastned does not state the session count, ambient temperature or preconditioning. Fastned page for the 65 kWh KONA Electric (2023+), data 8-100 %. Power rises from 94 to 105 kW to 61 %, then steps down to 80 kW, 49 kW and 41 kW (unusually, it peaks late); one source only. Applied to the 2026 Standard on the match of the 64.8 kWh pack figure (Hyundai Canada). The 48 kWh SE pack (2024-se, 2025-se) is not covered.
